    white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; color: rgba(255,255,255,.88);
    max-height: 240px; overflow: auto; user-select: text; cursor: text; }
  /* END UI PANEL */
</style>
<script type="importmap">
{
  "imports": {
    "three": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.143.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.143.0/examples/jsm/"
  }
}
</script>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene"></canvas>

<!-- UI PANEL — remove this block to drop the controls -->
<div id="ui-panel">
  <button id="ui-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Toggle controls">⚙ controls</button>
  <div id="ui-body"></div>
  <pre id="ui-snapshot" title="Click to select, then copy. These are the current CONFIG values."></pre>
</div>
<!-- END UI PANEL -->

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { EffectComposer } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js'
import { RenderPass } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/RenderPass.js'
import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js'
import { ShaderPass } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/ShaderPass.js'
import { GammaCorrectionShader } from 'three/addons/shaders/GammaCorrectionShader.js'
import { CopyShader } from 'three/addons/shaders/CopyShader.js'

/* ============================================================
   CONFIG  — every tweakable value lives here. Colors are '#rrggbb'
   strings; everything else is a number. The UI panel + localStorage
   persistence are generated from these keys.
   Scene: a living red TOPOGRAPHIC CONTOUR map — a domain-warped
   height field displaced on a real 3D plane, drawn as glowing
   fwidth-antialiased iso-lines (concentric closed loops) that
   flow, merge and split over time. Red core → pink edges, on black.
============================================================ */
const CONFIG = {
  lineColor:    '#ff1f2b',   // hot crimson core of the lines
  lineColor2:   '#ff5f93',   // pink outer / far lines
  dotColor:     '#ff4d63',   // faint sparkle dots between the lines
  bands:        13,          // number of contour rings across the height range
  lineWidth:    1.4,         // contour line thickness (in pixels)
  brightness:   0.95,        // overall line emission
  gradientMix:  0.5,         // how much the red→pink gradient follows position
  contrast:     0.55,        // per-contour brightness variation (some lines hotter)
  noiseScale:   0.32,        // spatial frequency of the field (fewer/bigger vs more/tighter loops)
  warp:         1.9,         // domain-warp strength — how curled the contours get
  flow:         0.045,       // how fast the field morphs/flows over time
  displace:     0.5,         // vertical relief of the terrain (0 = flat top-down map)
  dotDensity:   3.4,         // sparkle-dot grid frequency
  dotSize:      0.04,        // sparkle-dot radius
  dotAmount:    0.3,         // sparkle-dot brightness
  fade:         5.4,         // radial fade radius — dissolves the plane edge into black
  spin:         0.025,       // auto camera orbit speed
  camDist:      6.4,         // camera distance
  camElev:      1.12,        // camera elevation angle (radians; ~1.5 = straight down)
  frameY:       1.8,         // raise the look-at target → map sits LOWER in frame, black space on top
  parallax:     0.5,         // mouse parallax strength
  glow:         0.55,        // in-shader neon halo strength (replaces bloom — no flicker)
  glowWidth:    7.0          // in-shader halo falloff (pixels)
}

/* ---------- DEFAULTS + localStorage (load BEFORE building the scene) ---------- */
const DEFAULTS = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(CONFIG))
const STORAGE_KEY = 'getlayers:crimson-contour'
try { const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || 'null'); if (s) for (const k in s) if (k in CONFIG) CONFIG[k] = s[k] } catch (e) {}
function saveConfig() { try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(CONFIG)) } catch (e) {} }

/* ---------- LAYERS / HELPERS / FINAL PASS ---------- */
const LAYERS = { NONE: 0, TORUS_SCENE: 1, BLOOM_SCENE: 2, ENTIRE_SCENE: 3 }

function hexToVec3(hex) {
  const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16)
  return new THREE.Vector3(((n >> 16) & 255) / 255, ((n >> 8) & 255) / 255, (n & 255) / 255)
}

// Composite-only pass — scene + bloom over a clean black background.
const FinalPass = {
  uniforms: {
    tDiffuse: { value: null }, torusTexture: { value: null }, bloomTexture: { value: null }, haloTexture: { value: null }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = vec4(position, 1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; uniform sampler2D bloomTexture; uniform sampler2D torusTexture; uniform sampler2D haloTexture;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main() {
      vec3 halo = texture2D(haloTexture, vUv).xyz;
      gl_FragColor = vec4(texture2D(bloomTexture, vUv).xyz + texture2D(torusTexture, vUv).xyz + texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv).xyz + halo, 1.);
    }`
}

/* ---------- RENDERER / SCENE / CAMERA ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById('scene')
const renderer = new THREE.WebGL1Renderer({ canvas, antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' })
renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio)
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true; renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.VSMShadowMap
const scene = new THREE.Scene()
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x000000); scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x000000, 6, 16)
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 80)
camera.position.set(0, 4, 4)
camera.layers.enable(LAYERS.TORUS_SCENE); camera.layers.enable(LAYERS.BLOOM_SCENE); camera.layers.enable(LAYERS.ENTIRE_SCENE)
scene.add(camera)

/* ---------- COMPOSER (reduced bloom; final pass is composite-only) ---------- */
const renderScene = new RenderPass(scene, camera)
const torusComposer = new EffectComposer(renderer); torusComposer.renderToScreen = false
torusComposer.addPass(renderScene)
torusComposer.addPass(new ShaderPass(GammaCorrectionShader))
torusComposer.addPass(new UnrealBloomPass(new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight), 0.22, 0.2, 0))
torusComposer.addPass(new ShaderPass(CopyShader))
const bloomComposer = new EffectComposer(renderer); bloomComposer.renderToScreen = false
bloomComposer.addPass(renderScene)
const bloomPass = new UnrealBloomPass(new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight), 0.42, 0.45, 0.2)
bloomComposer.addPass(bloomPass)
bloomComposer.addPass(new ShaderPass(GammaCorrectionShader))
const finalPass = new ShaderPass(FinalPass)
finalPass.uniforms.bloomTexture.value = bloomComposer.renderTarget1.texture
finalPass.uniforms.torusTexture.value = torusComposer.renderTarget1.texture
const finalComposer = new EffectComposer(renderer)
finalComposer.addPass(renderScene); finalComposer.addPass(finalPass)

/* ---------- shared GLSL: value-noise fbm + IQ domain warp ---------- */
const NOISE_GLSL = `
  float hash(vec2 p){ p = fract(p * vec2(123.34, 345.45)); p += dot(p, p + 34.345); return fract(p.x * p.y); }
  float vnoise(vec2 p){
    vec2 i = floor(p), f = fract(p);
    float a = hash(i), b = hash(i + vec2(1.,0.)), c = hash(i + vec2(0.,1.)), d = hash(i + vec2(1.,1.));
    vec2 u = f * f * (3. - 2. * f);
    return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);
  }
  float fbm(vec2 p){
    float s = 0., a = 0.5, n = 0.;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++){ s += a * vnoise(p); n += a; a *= 0.5; p = p * 2.03 + vec2(11.7, 4.3); }
    return s / n;
  }
  // Returns the height (~0..1) plus, via out params, the warp field used for colour.
  float terrain(vec2 p, float t, float warp, out float grad){
    vec2 q = vec2(fbm(p + vec2(0.0, 0.0) + t), fbm(p + vec2(5.2, 1.3) - t));
    vec2 r = vec2(fbm(p + warp * q + vec2(1.7, 9.2) + 0.5 * t),
                  fbm(p + warp * q + vec2(8.3, 2.8) - 0.4 * t));
    grad = clamp(r.x, 0.0, 1.0);
    return fbm(p + warp * r);
  }
`

/* ============================================================
   SCENE: CRIMSON CONTOUR
============================================================ */
class ContourScene {
  constructor(scene) {
    this.uniforms = {
      uTime:        { value: 0 },
      uAlpha:       { value: 0 },
      uLineColor:   { value: hexToVec3(CONFIG.lineColor) },
      uLineColor2:  { value: hexToVec3(CONFIG.lineColor2) },
      uDotColor:    { value: hexToVec3(CONFIG.dotColor) },
      uBands:       { value: CONFIG.bands },
      uLineWidth:   { value: CONFIG.lineWidth },
      uBrightness:  { value: CONFIG.brightness },
      uGradientMix: { value: CONFIG.gradientMix },
      uContrast:    { value: CONFIG.contrast },
      uNoiseScale:  { value: CONFIG.noiseScale },
      uWarp:        { value: CONFIG.warp },
      uFlow:        { value: CONFIG.flow },
      uDisplace:    { value: CONFIG.displace },
      uDotDensity:  { value: CONFIG.dotDensity },
      uDotSize:     { value: CONFIG.dotSize },
      uDotAmount:   { value: CONFIG.dotAmount },
      uFade:        { value: CONFIG.fade },
      uGlow:        { value: CONFIG.glow },
      uGlowWidth:   { value: CONFIG.glowWidth }
    }

    this.geometry = new THREE.PlaneBufferGeometry(11, 11, 340, 340)
    this.material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: this.uniforms,
      transparent: true,
      depthWrite: false,
      blending: THREE.NormalBlending,
      extensions: { derivatives: true },
      vertexShader: `
        uniform float uTime, uNoiseScale, uWarp, uFlow, uDisplace;
        varying float vH; varying float vGrad; varying vec3 vWorld;
        ${NOISE_GLSL}
        void main(){
          vec2 p = position.xy * uNoiseScale;
          float t = uTime * uFlow;
          float grad;
          float h = terrain(p, t, uWarp, grad);
          vH = h; vGrad = grad;
          vec3 displaced = position + vec3(0.0, 0.0, h * uDisplace);   // object +Z → world +Y after the -90° rotation
          vec4 world = modelMatrix * vec4(displaced, 1.0);
          vWorld = world.xyz;
          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * world;
        }`,
      fragmentShader: `
        uniform vec3 uLineColor, uLineColor2, uDotColor;
        uniform float uBands, uLineWidth, uBrightness, uGradientMix, uContrast;
        uniform float uDotDensity, uDotSize, uDotAmount, uFade, uAlpha, uGlow, uGlowWidth;
        varying float vH; varying float vGrad; varying vec3 vWorld;
        void main(){
          // ---- contour iso-lines from the height field ----
          float g = vH * uBands;
          float w = fwidth(g);
          float dist = abs(fract(g - 0.5) - 0.5) / max(w, 1e-4);   // pixels to nearest contour
          float steep = 1.0 - smoothstep(1.6, 3.2, w);             // fade where contours collapse below a pixel (kills steep-slope aliasing)
          float core = (1.0 - smoothstep(uLineWidth - 0.5, uLineWidth + 0.5, dist)) * steep;
          // soft in-shader halo around each line — replaces UnrealBloom so the thin animated lines don't flicker
          float halo = exp(-dist / max(uGlowWidth, 0.5)) * uGlow * steep;
          float line = core + halo;

          // ---- red → pink gradient (follows the warp field + a broad spatial ramp) ----
          float gm = clamp(vGrad * 0.6 + (0.5 + 0.09 * vWorld.z) * uGradientMix, 0.0, 1.0);
          vec3 col = mix(uLineColor, uLineColor2, gm);

          // some contour rings run hotter than others
          float ring = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(floor(g) * 1.7 + 1.3);
          col *= uBrightness * (1.0 - uContrast + uContrast * ring);

          // ---- faint sparkle dots between the lines ----
          vec2 gp = vWorld.xz * uDotDensity;
          vec2 cell = abs(fract(gp) - 0.5);
          float dot = (1.0 - smoothstep(uDotSize, uDotSize + 0.03, length(cell))) * uDotAmount;

          vec3 outCol = col * line + uDotColor * dot;
          float alpha = clamp(max(line, dot), 0.0, 1.0);

          // ---- radial fade so the plane edge dissolves into black ----
          float rad = length(vWorld.xz);
          float fade = 1.0 - smoothstep(uFade * 0.55, uFade, rad);
          alpha *= fade * uAlpha;
          outCol *= fade;

          if (alpha < 0.003) discard;
          gl_FragColor = vec4(outCol, alpha);
        }`
    })

    this.mesh = new THREE.Mesh(this.geometry, this.material)
    this.mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2   // lay the plane flat in XZ
    this.mesh.layers.enable(LAYERS.ENTIRE_SCENE)   // ENTIRE_SCENE only — off BLOOM_SCENE so the thin animated lines don't flicker through UnrealBloom; glow is the in-shader halo instead
    scene.add(this.mesh)
    this.appearStart = performance.now()
  }

  resize() {}

  render() {
    this.uniforms.uTime.value = performance.now() / 1000
    const elapsed = performance.now() - this.appearStart
    this.uniforms.uAlpha.value = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (elapsed - 300) / 1200))
  }
}

const sceneObj = new ContourScene(scene)

/* ---------- POINTER PARALLAX + AUTO ORBIT (camera driven from CONFIG) ---------- */
const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0 }
window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  pointer.tx = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1
  pointer.ty = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 - 1
})
let autoAz = 0
function updateCamera(dt) {
  pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.05
  pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.05
  autoAz += CONFIG.spin * dt
  const az = autoAz + pointer.x * CONFIG.parallax
  const el = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1.45, CONFIG.camElev - pointer.y * 0.35 * CONFIG.parallax))
  const R = CONFIG.camDist
  camera.position.set(Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el) * R, Math.sin(el) * R, Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el) * R)
  camera.lookAt(0, CONFIG.displace * 0.25 + CONFIG.frameY, 0)
}

/* ---------- CONFIG → uniforms ---------- */
function applyConfig() {
  const u = sceneObj.uniforms
  u.uLineColor.value.copy(hexToVec3(CONFIG.lineColor))
  u.uLineColor2.value.copy(hexToVec3(CONFIG.lineColor2))
  u.uDotColor.value.copy(hexToVec3(CONFIG.dotColor))
  u.uBands.value = CONFIG.bands
  u.uLineWidth.value = CONFIG.lineWidth
  u.uBrightness.value = CONFIG.brightness
  u.uGradientMix.value = CONFIG.gradientMix
  u.uContrast.value = CONFIG.contrast
  u.uNoiseScale.value = CONFIG.noiseScale
  u.uWarp.value = CONFIG.warp
  u.uFlow.value = CONFIG.flow
  u.uDisplace.value = CONFIG.displace
  u.uDotDensity.value = CONFIG.dotDensity
  u.uDotSize.value = CONFIG.dotSize
  u.uDotAmount.value = CONFIG.dotAmount
  u.uFade.value = CONFIG.fade
  u.uGlow.value = CONFIG.glow
  u.uGlowWidth.value = CONFIG.glowWidth
}

/* ---------- RESIZE ---------- */
function resize() {
  const w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight, dpr = window.devicePixelRatio
  renderer.setPixelRatio(dpr); renderer.setSize(w, h, false)
  camera.aspect = w / h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
  for (const c of [torusComposer, bloomComposer, finalComposer]) { c.setPixelRatio(dpr); c.setSize(w, h) }
  sceneObj.resize()
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize()

/* ---------- RENDER LOOP ---------- */
let last = performance.now()
function render() {
  requestAnimationFrame(render)
  const now = performance.now(); const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now
  updateCamera(dt)
  sceneObj.render()
  camera.layers.set(LAYERS.TORUS_SCENE);  torusComposer.render()
  camera.layers.set(LAYERS.BLOOM_SCENE);  bloomComposer.render()
  camera.layers.set(LAYERS.ENTIRE_SCENE); finalComposer.render()
}
render()

/* ===== UI (remove this block to drop the panel) ===== */
function setupColorUI(config, apply) {
  const panel = document.getElementById('ui-panel')
  const toggle = document.getElementById('ui-toggle')
  const body = document.getElementById('ui-body')
  if (!panel) return
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => panel.classList.toggle('-open'))
  const _apply = apply
  apply = () => { _apply(); saveConfig(); renderSnapshot(config) }
  const numericRanges = {
    bands:       { min: 3,    max: 40,  step: 1 },
    lineWidth:   { min: 0.3,  max: 5,   step: 0.1 },
    brightness:  { min: 0,    max: 3,   step: 0.01 },
    gradientMix: { min: 0,    max: 1,   step: 0.01 },
    contrast:    { min: 0,    max: 1,   step: 0.01 },
    noiseScale:  { min: 0.1,  max: 1.2, step: 0.01 },
    warp:        { min: 0,    max: 4,   step: 0.05 },
    flow:        { min: 0,    max: 0.4, step: 0.005 },
    displace:    { min: 0,    max: 2,   step: 0.01 },
    dotDensity:  { min: 0.5,  max: 10,  step: 0.1 },
    dotSize:     { min: 0,    max: 0.3, step: 0.005 },
    dotAmount:   { min: 0,    max: 1,   step: 0.01 },
    fade:        { min: 2,    max: 6,   step: 0.1 },
    spin:        { min: -0.4, max: 0.4, step: 0.005 },
    camDist:     { min: 3,    max: 12,  step: 0.1 },
    camElev:     { min: 0.15, max: 1.45, step: 0.01 },
    frameY:      { min: 0,    max: 4,   step: 0.05 },
    parallax:    { min: 0,    max: 1.5, step: 0.01 },
    glow:        { min: 0,    max: 2,   step: 0.01 },
    glowWidth:   { min: 0.5,  max: 20,  step: 0.5 }
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(config)) {
    const v = config[key]
    const row = document.createElement('label')
    row.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: key }))
    if (typeof v === 'string' && v[0] === '#') {
      const inp = document.createElement('input')
      inp.type = 'color'; inp.value = v
      inp.addEventListener('input', e => { config[key] = e.target.value; apply() })
      row.appendChild(inp)
    } else if (typeof v === 'number') {
      const r = numericRanges[key] || { min: 0, max: Math.max(1, v * 2), step: 0.01 }
      const inp = document.createElement('input')
      inp.type = 'range'; inp.min = String(r.min); inp.max = String(r.max); inp.step = String(r.step); inp.value = String(v)
      inp.addEventListener('input', e => {
        let val = parseFloat(e.target.value)
        if (Number.isInteger(r.step)) val = Math.round(val / r.step) * r.step
        config[key] = val
        apply()
      })
      row.appendChild(inp)
    }
    body.appendChild(row)
  }
  const btns = document.createElement('div'); btns.id = 'ui-buttons'
  const reloadBtn = document.createElement('button'); reloadBtn.type = 'button'; reloadBtn.textContent = '⟳ reload'
  const resetBtn  = document.createElement('button'); resetBtn.type = 'button'; resetBtn.textContent = '↺ reset'
  reloadBtn.title = 'Reload the page — re-initialise the scene with the saved settings'
  resetBtn.title = 'Clear saved settings and reload with defaults'
  reloadBtn.addEventListener('click', () => location.reload())
  resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY) } catch (e) {} ; location.reload() })
  btns.appendChild(reloadBtn); btns.appendChild(resetBtn)
  body.appendChild(btns)
  panel.classList.add('-open')
  renderSnapshot(config)
}
function renderSnapshot(config) {
  const snap = document.getElementById('ui-snapshot')
  if (!snap) return
  const lines = ['const CONFIG = {']
  for (const key of Object.keys(config)) {
    const v = config[key]
    let formatted
    if (typeof v === 'string') formatted = "'" + v + "'"
    else if (Number.isInteger(v)) formatted = String(v)
    else formatted = String(parseFloat(v.toFixed(4)))
    lines.push('  ' + key + ': ' + formatted + ',')
  }
  lines.push('}')
  snap.textContent = lines.join('\n')
}
applyConfig()
setupColorUI(CONFIG, applyConfig)
/* ===== END UI ===== */
</script>
</body>
</html>

pass is composite-only) ---------- */\nconst renderScene = new RenderPass(scene, camera)\nconst torusComposer = new EffectComposer(renderer); torusComposer.renderToScreen = false\ntorusComposer.addPass(renderScene)\ntorusComposer.addPass(new ShaderPass(GammaCorrectionShader))\ntorusComposer.addPass(new UnrealBloomPass(new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight), 0.22, 0.2, 0))\ntorusComposer.addPass(new ShaderPass(CopyShader))\nconst bloomComposer = new EffectComposer(renderer); bloomComposer.renderToScreen = false\nbloomComposer.addPass(renderScene)\nconst bloomPass = new UnrealBloomPass(new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight), 0.42, 0.45, 0.2)\nbloomComposer.addPass(bloomPass)\nbloomComposer.addPass(new ShaderPass(GammaCorrectionShader))\nconst finalPass = new ShaderPass(FinalPass)\nfinalPass.uniforms.bloomTexture.value = bloomComposer.renderTarget1.texture\nfinalPass.uniforms.torusTexture.value = torusComposer.renderTarget1.texture\nconst finalComposer = new EffectComposer(renderer)\nfinalComposer.addPass(renderScene); finalComposer.addPass(finalPass)\n\n/* ---------- shared GLSL: value-noise fbm + IQ domain warp ---------- */\nconst NOISE_GLSL = `\n  float hash(vec2 p){ p = fract(p * vec2(123.34, 345.45)); p += dot(p, p + 34.345); return fract(p.x * p.y); }\n  float vnoise(vec2 p){\n    vec2 i = floor(p), f = fract(p);\n    float a = hash(i), b = hash(i + vec2(1.,0.)), c = hash(i + vec2(0.,1.)), d = hash(i + vec2(1.,1.));\n    vec2 u = f * f * (3. - 2. * f);\n    return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);\n  }\n  float fbm(vec2 p){\n    float s = 0., a = 0.5, n = 0.;\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++){ s += a * vnoise(p); n += a; a *= 0.5; p = p * 2.03 + vec2(11.7, 4.3); }\n    return s / n;\n  }\n  // Returns the height (~0..1) plus, via out params, the warp field used for colour.\n  float terrain(vec2 p, float t, float warp, out float grad){\n    vec2 q = vec2(fbm(p + vec2(0.0, 0.0) + t), fbm(p + vec2(5.2, 1.3) - t));\n    vec2 r = vec2(fbm(p + warp * q + vec2(1.7, 9.2) + 0.5 * t),\n                  fbm(p + warp * q + vec2(8.3, 2.8) - 0.4 * t));\n    grad = clamp(r.x, 0.0, 1.0);\n    return fbm(p + warp * r);\n  }\n`\n\n/* ============================================================\n   SCENE: CRIMSON CONTOUR\n============================================================ */\nclass ContourScene {\n  constructor(scene) {\n    this.uniforms = {\n      uTime:        { value: 0 },\n      uAlpha:       { value: 0 },\n      uLineColor:   { value: hexToVec3(CONFIG.lineColor) },\n      uLineColor2:  { value: hexToVec3(CONFIG.lineColor2) },\n      uDotColor:    { value: hexToVec3(CONFIG.dotColor) },\n      uBands:       { value: CONFIG.bands },\n      uLineWidth:   { value: CONFIG.lineWidth },\n      uBrightness:  { value: CONFIG.brightness },\n      uGradientMix: { value: CONFIG.gradientMix },\n      uContrast:    { value: CONFIG.contrast },\n      uNoiseScale:  { value: CONFIG.noiseScale },\n      uWarp:        { value: CONFIG.warp },\n      uFlow:        { value: CONFIG.flow },\n      uDisplace:    { value: CONFIG.displace },\n      uDotDensity:  { value: CONFIG.dotDensity },\n      uDotSize:     { value: CONFIG.dotSize },\n      uDotAmount:   { value: CONFIG.dotAmount },\n      uFade:        { value: CONFIG.fade },\n      uGlow:        { value: CONFIG.glow },\n      uGlowWidth:   { value: CONFIG.glowWidth }\n    }\n\n    this.geometry = new THREE.PlaneBufferGeometry(11, 11, 340, 340)\n    this.material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({\n      uniforms: this.uniforms,\n      transparent: true,\n      depthWrite: false,\n      blending: THREE.NormalBlending,\n      extensions: { derivatives: true },\n      vertexShader: `\n        uniform float uTime, uNoiseScale, uWarp, uFlow, uDisplace;\n        varying float vH; varying float vGrad; varying vec3 vWorld;\n        ${NOISE_GLSL}\n        void main(){\n          vec2 p = position.xy * uNoiseScale;\n          float t = uTime * uFlow;\n          float grad;\n          float h = terrain(p, t, uWarp, grad);\n          vH = h; vGrad = grad;\n          vec3 displaced = position + vec3(0.0, 0.0, h * uDisplace);   // object +Z → world +Y after the -90° rotation\n          vec4 world = modelMatrix * vec4(displaced, 1.0);\n          vWorld = world.xyz;\n          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * world;\n        }`,\n      fragmentShader: `\n        uniform vec3 uLineColor, uLineColor2, uDotColor;\n        uniform float uBands, uLineWidth, uBrightness, uGradientMix, uContrast;\n        uniform float uDotDensity, uDotSize, uDotAmount, uFade, uAlpha, uGlow, uGlowWidth;\n        varying float vH; varying float vGrad; varying vec3 vWorld;\n        void main(){\n          // ---- contour iso-lines from the height field ----\n          float g = vH * uBands;\n          float w = fwidth(g);\n          float dist = abs(fract(g - 0.5) - 0.5) / max(w, 1e-4);   // pixels to nearest contour\n          float steep = 1.0 - smoothstep(1.6, 3.2, w);             // fade where contours collapse below a pixel (kills steep-slope aliasing)\n          float core = (1.0 - smoothstep(uLineWidth - 0.5, uLineWidth + 0.5, dist)) * steep;\n          // soft in-shader halo around each line — replaces UnrealBloom so the thin animated lines don't flicker\n          float halo = exp(-dist / max(uGlowWidth, 0.5)) * uGlow * steep;\n          float line = core + halo;\n\n          // ---- red → pink gradient (follows the warp field + a broad spatial ramp) ----\n          float gm = clamp(vGrad * 0.6 + (0.5 + 0.09 * vWorld.z) * uGradientMix, 0.0, 1.0);\n          vec3 col = mix(uLineColor, uLineColor2, gm);\n\n          // some contour rings run hotter than others\n          float ring = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(floor(g) * 1.7 + 1.3);\n          col *= uBrightness * (1.0 - uContrast + uContrast * ring);\n\n          // ---- faint sparkle dots between the lines ----\n          vec2 gp = vWorld.xz * uDotDensity;\n          vec2 cell = abs(fract(gp) - 0.5);\n          float dot = (1.0 - smoothstep(uDotSize, uDotSize + 0.03, length(cell))) * uDotAmount;\n\n          vec3 outCol = col * line + uDotColor * dot;\n          float alpha = clamp(max(line, dot), 0.0, 1.0);\n\n          // ---- radial fade so the plane edge dissolves into black ----\n          float rad = length(vWorld.xz);\n          float fade = 1.0 - smoothstep(uFade * 0.55, uFade, rad);\n          alpha *= fade * uAlpha;\n          outCol *= fade;\n\n          if (alpha < 0.003) discard;\n          gl_FragColor = vec4(outCol, alpha);\n        }`\n    })\n\n    this.mesh = new THREE.Mesh(this.geometry, this.material)\n    this.mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2   // lay the plane flat in XZ\n    this.mesh.layers.enable(LAYERS.ENTIRE_SCENE)   // ENTIRE_SCENE only — off BLOOM_SCENE so the thin animated lines don't flicker through UnrealBloom; glow is the in-shader halo instead\n    scene.add(this.mesh)\n    this.appearStart = performance.now()\n  }\n\n  resize() {}\n\n  render() {\n    this.uniforms.uTime.value = performance.now() / 1000\n    const elapsed = performance.now() - this.appearStart\n    this.uniforms.uAlpha.value = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (elapsed - 300) / 1200))\n  }\n}\n\nconst sceneObj = new ContourScene(scene)\n\n/* ---------- POINTER PARALLAX + AUTO ORBIT (camera driven from CONFIG) ---------- */\nconst pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0 }\nwindow.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {\n  pointer.tx = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1\n  pointer.ty = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 - 1\n})\nlet autoAz = 0\nfunction updateCamera(dt) {\n  pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.05\n  pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.05\n  autoAz += CONFIG.spin * dt\n  const az = autoAz + pointer.x * CONFIG.parallax\n  const el = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1.45, CONFIG.camElev - pointer.y * 0.35 * CONFIG.parallax))\n  const R = CONFIG.camDist\n  camera.position.set(Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el) * R, Math.sin(el) * R, Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el) * R)\n  camera.lookAt(0, CONFIG.displace * 0.25 + CONFIG.frameY, 0)\n}\n\n/* ---------- CONFIG → uniforms ---------- */\nfunction applyConfig() {\n  const u = sceneObj.uniforms\n  u.uLineColor.value.copy(hexToVec3(CONFIG.lineColor))\n  u.uLineColor2.value.copy(hexToVec3(CONFIG.lineColor2))\n  u.uDotColor.value.copy(hexToVec3(CONFIG.dotColor))\n  u.uBands.value = CONFIG.bands\n  u.uLineWidth.value = CONFIG.lineWidth\n  u.uBrightness.value = CONFIG.brightness\n  u.uGradientMix.value = CONFIG.gradientMix\n  u.uContrast.value = CONFIG.contrast\n  u.uNoiseScale.value = CONFIG.noiseScale\n  u.uWarp.value = CONFIG.warp\n  u.uFlow.value = CONFIG.flow\n  u.uDisplace.value = CONFIG.displace\n  u.uDotDensity.value = CONFIG.dotDensity\n  u.uDotSize.value = CONFIG.dotSize\n  u.uDotAmount.value = CONFIG.dotAmount\n  u.uFade.value = CONFIG.fade\n  u.uGlow.value = CONFIG.glow\n  u.uGlowWidth.value = CONFIG.glowWidth\n}\n\n/* ---------- RESIZE ---------- */\nfunction resize() {\n  const w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight, dpr = window.devicePixelRatio\n  renderer.setPixelRatio(dpr); renderer.setSize(w, h, false)\n  camera.aspect = w / h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix()\n  for (const c of [torusComposer, bloomComposer, finalComposer]) { c.setPixelRatio(dpr); c.setSize(w, h) }\n  sceneObj.resize()\n}\nwindow.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize()\n\n/* ---------- RENDER LOOP ---------- */\nlet last = performance.now()\nfunction render() {\n  requestAnimationFrame(render)\n  const now = performance.now(); const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now\n  updateCamera(dt)\n  sceneObj.render()\n  camera.layers.set(LAYERS.TORUS_SCENE);  torusComposer.render()\n  camera.layers.set(LAYERS.BLOOM_SCENE);  bloomComposer.render()\n  camera.layers.set(LAYERS.ENTIRE_SCENE); finalComposer.render()\n}\nrender()\n\n/* ===== UI (remove this block to drop the panel) ===== */\nfunction setupColorUI(config, apply) {\n  const panel = document.getElementById('ui-panel')\n  const toggle = document.getElementById('ui-toggle')\n  const body = document.getElementById('ui-body')\n  if (!panel) return\n  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => panel.classList.toggle('-open'))\n  const _apply = apply\n  apply = () => { _apply(); saveConfig(); renderSnapshot(config) }\n  const numericRanges = {\n    bands:       { min: 3,    max: 40,  step: 1 },\n    lineWidth:   { min: 0.3,  max: 5,   step: 0.1 },\n    brightness:  { min: 0,    max: 3,   step: 0.01 },\n    gradientMix: { min: 0,    max: 1,   step: 0.01 },\n    contrast:    { min: 0,    max: 1,   step: 0.01 },\n    noiseScale:  { min: 0.1,  max: 1.2, step: 0.01 },\n    warp:        { min: 0,    max: 4,   step: 0.05 },\n    flow:        { min: 0,    max: 0.4, step: 0.005 },\n    displace:    { min: 0,    max: 2,   step: 0.01 },\n    dotDensity:  { min: 0.5,  max: 10,  step: 0.1 },\n    dotSize:     { min: 0,    max: 0.3, step: 0.005 },\n    dotAmount:   { min: 0,    max: 1,   step: 0.01 },\n    fade:        { min: 2,    max: 6,   step: 0.1 },\n    spin:        { min: -0.4, max: 0.4, step: 0.005 },\n    camDist:     { min: 3,    max: 12,  step: 0.1 },\n    camElev:     { min: 0.15, max: 1.45, step: 0.01 },\n    frameY:      { min: 0,    max: 4,   step: 0.05 },\n    parallax:    { min: 0,    max: 1.5, step: 0.01 },\n    glow:        { min: 0,    max: 2,   step: 0.01 },\n    glowWidth:   { min: 0.5,  max: 20,  step: 0.5 }\n  }\n  for (const key of Object.keys(config)) {\n    const v = config[key]\n    const row = document.createElement('label')\n    row.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { textContent: key }))\n    if (typeof v === 'string' && v[0] === '#') {\n      const inp = document.createElement('input')\n      inp.type = 'color'; inp.value = v\n      inp.addEventListener('input', e => { config[key] = e.target.value; apply() })\n      row.appendChild(inp)\n    } else if (typeof v === 'number') {\n      const r = numericRanges[key] || { min: 0, max: Math.max(1, v * 2), step: 0.01 }\n      const inp = document.createElement('input')\n      inp.type = 'range'; inp.min = String(r.min); inp.max = String(r.max); inp.step = String(r.step); inp.value = String(v)\n      inp.addEventListener('input', e => {\n        let val = parseFloat(e.target.value)\n        if (Number.isInteger(r.step)) val = Math.round(val / r.step) * r.step\n        config[key] = val\n        apply()\n      })\n      row.appendChild(inp)\n    }\n    body.appendChild(row)\n  }\n  const btns = document.createElement('div'); btns.id = 'ui-buttons'\n  const reloadBtn = document.createElement('button'); reloadBtn.type = 'button'; reloadBtn.textContent = '⟳ reload'\n  const resetBtn  = document.createElement('button'); resetBtn.type = 'button'; resetBtn.textContent = '↺ reset'\n  reloadBtn.title = 'Reload the page — re-initialise the scene with the saved settings'\n  resetBtn.title = 'Clear saved settings and reload with defaults'\n  reloadBtn.addEventListener('click', () => location.reload())\n  resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY) } catch (e) {} ; location.reload() })\n  btns.appendChild(reloadBtn); btns.appendChild(resetBtn)\n  body.appendChild(btns)\n  panel.classList.add('-open')\n  renderSnapshot(config)\n}\nfunction renderSnapshot(config) {\n  const snap = document.getElementById('ui-snapshot')\n  if (!snap) return\n  const lines = ['const CONFIG = {']\n  for (const key of Object.keys(config)) {\n    const v = config[key]\n    let formatted\n    if (typeof v === 'string') formatted = \"'\" + v + \"'\"\n    else if (Number.isInteger(v)) formatted = String(v)\n    else formatted = String(parseFloat(v.toFixed(4)))\n    lines.push('  ' + key + ': ' + formatted + ',')\n  }\n  lines.push('}')\n  snap.textContent = lines.join('\\n')\n}\napplyConfig()\nsetupColorUI(CONFIG, applyConfig)\n/* ===== END UI ===== */\n</script>\n</body>\n</html>\n"

# 7. getlayers_compositions — les 109 squelettes de mise en page
Choose a skeleton that fits the section, then BUILD to it: place the real elements in its slots, honour its type scale / spacing / balance, and skin it with the committed Style. Combine skeletons across a page for rhythm (see each one's pairsWith). These are references, not rigid templates — adapt, but do not fall back to a generic stack.

## role : about (2)

### artist-about — heading-left-paragraphs-right-over-triptych-and-fact-ledger
Three stacked registers: a 7|5 top row where a display heading faces a stack of three short paragraphs, then an equal three-up image triptych, then a four-cell label/value ledger under a hairline — each register wider and quieter than the one above.
```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ── EYEBROW                    │ paragraph one, ~52ch    │
│ HEADLINE                      │                         │
│ HEADLINE                      │ paragraph two           │
│ HEADLINE                      │                         │
│                               │ paragraph three         │
│                                                        │
│ ┌────────────┐ ┌────────────┐ ┌────────────┐           │
│ │  plate 1   │ │  plate 2   │ │  plate 3   │           │
│ └────────────┘ └────────────┘ └────────────┘           │
│ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ LABEL      LABEL      LABEL      LABEL                 │
│ value      value      value      value                 │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### marcus-vane-story — statement-left-ruled-list-right
A twelve-column split: an eyebrow, a very short display statement and a lead paragraph hold the left half, while the right half runs a stack of numbered principle rows separated only by hairline rules.
```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ◦ eyebrow          │ ───────────────────────── │
│                    │ 01  Row title             │
│ SHORT DISPLAY      │     row body copy, short  │
│ STATEMENT SET TO   │ ───────────────────────── │
│ A NARROW MEASURE   │ 02  Row title             │
│                    │     row body copy, short  │
│ lead paragraph on  │ ───────────────────────── │
│ a medium measure   │ 03  Row title             │
│                    │ ───────────────────────── │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### artist-faq — narrow-heading-column-beside-ruled-accordion
A 4|8 split: a short heading column on the left leaves the accordion two thirds of the grid, where each row is a hairline-topped full-width button with the question in the display face at the left and a plus glyph pushed hard right that rotates as the answer opens.
```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ── EYEBROW      │ ──────────────────────────────────────│
│ HEADLINE        │ Question one                        + │
│ HEADLINE        │ ──────────────────────────────────────│
│ HEADLINE        │ Question two                        ✕ │
│ HEADLINE        │   answer paragraph, ~60ch             │
│                 │   (panel opens to measured height)    │
│                 │ ──────────────────────────────────────│
│                 │ Question three                      + │
│                 │ ──────────────────────────────────────│
│                 │ Question four                       + │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

### artist-works — alternating-seven-of-twelve-offset-plate-column
A heading block sits above a 12-column field where each work occupies seven columns and alternates side — odd items start at column 1, even items start at column 6 and are pushed down a further section-height — so the plates interleave down the page instead of forming rows.

│ HEADLINE                                               │
│ HEADLINE                                               │

│ └──────────────────────┘                               │
│ ────────────────────────                               │

│                                 │      plate 02        │
│                                 │  (offset down)       │
│ ┌──────────────────────┐        └──────────────────────┘
│ │      plate 03        │        ───────────────────────│
│ └──────────────────────┘        title / medium    year │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### forma-hero — gutter-inset-viewport-frame-with-flexible-media-band

│ │                                              │ │

### artist-exhibitions — three-column-ruled-index-lattice
A tonal band where a heading sits over a three-column list with no column gap — every cell opens with its own hairline and carries a two-digit index beside a display-face name, so the cells knit into a continuous ruled lattice rather than three separate lists.
```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  (tonal ground shift — a grey band in a white page)     │
│ ── EYEBROW                                             │
│ HEADLINE                                               │
│                                                        │
│ ────────────────┬────────────────┬──────────────────── │
│ 01  Entry name  │ 02  Entry name │ 03  Entry name      │
│ ────────────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────── │
│ 04  Entry name  │ 05  Entry name │ 06  Entry name      │
│ ────────────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────── │
│ 07  Entry name  │ 08  Entry name │ 09  Entry name      │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
   (no column gutter — the rules run edge to edge)
```

### lumora-create-band — four-up-word-band-of-equal-pills
A single full-width band of four equal pill-shaped tiles, each holding one enormous centred word — the tiles differ only in fill (quiet, accent, solid, ghosted) and one of them carries a directional glyph instead of a word, so the row reads as a four-beat sentence.
```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ╭──────────╮ ╭──────────╮ ╭──────────╮ ╭──────────╮ │
│ │          │ │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│ │██████████│ │░░░░░░░░░░│ │
│ │   WORD   │ │▓▓ WORD ▓▓│ │███  →  ██│ │░░ word ░░│ │
│ │          │ │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│ │██████████│ │░░░░░░░░░░│ │
│ ╰──────────╯ ╰──────────╯ ╰──────────╯ ╰──────────╯ │
│    quiet        accent        solid        ghost     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### altitude-stats — translucent-base-rail-with-flanking-figures-around-a-centred-pitch
A shallow translucent rail pinned to the base of the frame and opened by a hairline: a figure-over-label pair on each flank, and a centred column between them holding a short title, a dot, and a two-line pitch. The flanks are content-sized and the centre is measured, so the pitch stays on the page's axis whatever the figures read.
```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  00+          title line               00K   │
│  label             ·                 label   │
│            short pitch copy on a             │
│               narrow measure                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘

narrow:
┌────────────────────┐
│     title line     │
│         ·          │
│   short pitch copy │
│ 00+          00K   │
│ label       label  │
└────────────────────┘

      "weight": "quiet"

On a section/DOM: map roles → the --gl-* colour tokens (background→gl-bg, primary→gl-ink, secondary→gl-bg-alt/surface, accent→gl-accent), use `ink` for legible text, and `swatch` for any gradient. # 10. getlayers_materialize — contrats et consignes d'adaptation (exemples réels)

## obsidian-luxe (style) — appel {"id": "obsidian-luxe", "styleId": "obsidian-luxe", "target": "other"}

### contract
```json
{
  "mutable": [
    "skin"
  ],
  "preserve": [],
  "notes": "A Style is all skin by definition. Overriding individual tokens is fine; adding new token names is not — anything outside the canonical --gl-* set will not be read by the sections."
}
```

### adaptation
Target is the user's own stack. Read the host project's conventions FIRST, then TRANSLATE the source into that stack (its component idiom, its styling system, its token names). Preserve the layers in `contract.preserve`; re-skin the rest. Adapt freely — the format never blocks you.

## loader-marcus-vane (section) — appel {"id": "loader-marcus-vane", "styleId": "obsidian-luxe", "target": "other"}

### contract
```json
{
  "mutable": [
    "skin",
    "composition"
  ],
  "preserve": [
    "motion"
  ],
  "notes": "The numbers ARE the asset: a 2000ms linear 0→100 count, a 300ms label fade at completion, a 200ms hold, then a tension-90 / friction-20 spring lifting the plate a full viewport height, and only on that spring's rest does scroll unlock. The content underneath does not wait for the curtain — its reveal is scheduled on an absolute 2500ms clock from mount, so the headline is already rising as the plate clears. Do not convert that to a callback, do not 'tidy' the overlap, and do not shorten the count to feel snappier — the hand-off reads as one continuous move only because the two timelines cross. Corner placement and copy are yours; retint through the tokens."
}
```

### adaptation
Target is the user's own stack. Read the host project's conventions FIRST, then TRANSLATE the source into that stack (its component idiom, its styling system, its token names). Preserve the layers in `contract.preserve`; re-skin the rest. Adapt freely — the format never blocks you.

### sourceNote
This is a self-contained single HTML file — the canonical, framework-agnostic form of the asset. Take it AS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH and adapt it to whatever the user is building in: for the starter or any React/Next app, port it into a component; for Astro/Vue/Svelte/WordPress/plain HTML, translate accordingly; for a quick test it runs as-is in any page. Do not treat "single HTML" as a downgrade — it is the portable master. Re-skin via its CSS custom properties, mapping them onto the committed Style tokens; preserve the motion.

### source
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Section · Percent Curtain Loader</title>
<!--
  ODORO · Section — Percent Curtain Loader  (loader-marcus-vane)

  A near-empty dark plate with a wordmark in one corner and a huge percent counter in the
  other. The count runs 0→100, the labels blink out, the whole plate lifts like a curtain,
  and scroll unlocks the instant it settles. Underneath, the page content is ALREADY
  moving — its reveal runs on its own absolute clock, so the two timelines cross and the
  hand-off reads as one continuous move rather than two beats.

  THE TIMING IS THE ASSET. Every number lives in CONFIG below, lifted verbatim from the
  Marcus Vane template (src/components/sections/preloader.tsx + hero.tsx). The production
  build drives these with @react-spring/web and spring-text-engine; here, the two
  physics springs are integrated with react-spring's own solver (1ms fixed step,
  tension·1e-6 / friction·1e-3) so they are literally the same curve, and the two
  duration+easing reveals are CSS transitions on easeOutExpo, which is exactly what
  spring-text-engine emits for a `{duration, easing}` config.

  Self-contained: no libraries, no media. The template's hero portrait (a transparent
  cutout under an SVG turbulence/displacement filter) is stood in for here by a CSS
  silhouette block — it is a stage prop, not part of the loader mechanic.

  Re-skin surface: the --gl-* tokens in the :root block. Nothing else carries colour.
  Type: Anton (display) + Onest (body), Google Fonts.
-->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Onest:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* ==========================================================================
     TOKENS — the entire skin surface. Swap these to re-dress the section.
     ========================================================================== */
  :root {
    --gl-bg:            #08080a;
    --gl-ink:           #f3f1ea;
    --gl-ink-muted:     #807f78;
    --gl-accent:        #ff3b1d;
    --gl-line:          rgba(243, 241, 234, .10);

    --gl-font-display:  'Anton', 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif;
    --gl-font-body:     'Onest', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif;
    --gl-tracking-display: -.01em;
    --gl-weight-display: 400;

    --gl-duration:      300ms;   /* label blink-out at 100% */
    --gl-duration-slow: 900ms;   /* the long per-letter rise */
    --gl-ease:          cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1);   /* easeOutExpo */

    /* layout constants (not skin) */
    --gutter: 2.5rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { :root { --gutter: 16px; } }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: var(--gl-bg); }
  /* THE GATE, part 1 — the document cannot scroll while `-gated` is set.
     In the template this is Lenis `stop()` plus html{overflow:hidden}; the
     store flag and the DOM lock are the same latch. */
  html.-gated { overflow: hidden; height: 100%; position: relative; }

  body {
    font-family: var(--gl-font-body);
    color: var(--gl-ink);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  .disp {
    font-family: var(--gl-font-display);
    font-weight: var(--gl-weight-display);
    letter-spacing: var(--gl-tracking-display);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     THE LOADER PLATE
     Two corners of an empty field: wordmark and counter. Nothing else.
     ========================================================================== */
  #loader {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: .75rem; padding: var(--gutter);
    background: var(--gl-bg);
    will-change: transform;
  }
  @media (min-width: 641px) {
    #loader { flex-direction: row; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; }
  }
  #loader .ld-name  { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(20px, 1.6vw, 30px); }
  #loader .ld-count { margin: 0; flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: clamp(64px, 7.5vw, 150px);
                      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #loader .ld-count i { font-style: normal; color: var(--gl-accent); }
  /* the blink-out — opacity only, and only at 100 */
  #loader .ld-name, #loader .ld-count { opacity: 1; transition: opacity var(--gl-duration) linear; }
  #loader.-done .ld-name, #loader.-done .ld-count { opacity: 0; }

  /* ==========================================================================
     THE CONTENT UNDERNEATH — a stand-in page section, so the hand-off is
     visible. Its reveal choreography is the template's, verbatim.
     ========================================================================== */
  #page { position: relative; width: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }
  .hero {
    position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 100svh; overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* top row — stacked role words left, short intro right */
  .hero__top {
    position: relative; z-index: 30;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2rem;
    padding: 7rem var(--gutter) 0;
  }
  @media (min-width: 641px) {
    .hero__top { flex-direction: row; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 8rem; }
  }
  .hero__roles { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(28px, 2.9vw, 56px); line-height: 1.05; }
  .hero__intro {
    margin: 0; max-width: 26rem;
    font-size: clamp(14px, .95vw, 18px); line-height: 1.6; color: var(--gl-ink-muted);
  }
  @media (min-width: 641px) { .hero__intro { text-align: right; } }

  /* the figure column — a STAND-IN for the template's cutout portrait */
  .hero__figure {
    position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 20; height: 86vh; width: 80vw; pointer-events: none;
  }
  @media (min-width: 641px) { .hero__figure { width: 48vw; } }
  @media (min-width: 1025px) { .hero__figure { width: 36vw; } }
  .hero__figure::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(46% 34% at 50% 16%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--gl-ink) 26%, transparent) 0%, transparent 68%),
      radial-gradient(62% 52% at 50% 74%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--gl-ink) 18%, transparent) 0%, transparent 72%);
  }
  .hero__figure span {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 46%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    font-size: clamp(9px, .7vw, 12px); letter-spacing: .28em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gl-ink) 22%, transparent); white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* the scrim that melts the figure's base and the wordmark into the ground */
  .hero__scrim {
    position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 20; height: 26vh;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--gl-bg));
  }

  /* the colossal wordmark — two lines, clipped by all three edges, BEHIND the figure */
  .hero__mark {
    position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 10;
    margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
    transform: translateY(6%);
    font-size: clamp(88px, 23vw, 460px); line-height: .78;
    color: var(--gl-accent);
  }
  .hero__mark .ln { display: block; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; }

  /* scroll cue */
  .hero__cue {
    position: absolute; bottom: 2rem; left: var(--gutter); z-index: 30;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(11px, .7vw, 13px); letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gl-ink-muted);
  }
  .hero__cue b { display: inline-block; width: 2.5rem; height: 1px; background: var(--gl-accent); }

  /* a second block, so there is somewhere to scroll once the gate opens */
  .after {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--gl-line);
    padding: 9rem var(--gutter);
    font-size: clamp(14px, .95vw, 18px); line-height: 1.6; color: var(--gl-ink-muted);
  }
  .after p { max-width: 46ch; margin: 0; }

  /* ==========================================================================
     REVEAL PRIMITIVES
     .ln>.lt  — per-letter rise out of a line mask   (duration + easing)
     .lnmask  — whole-line rise out of a mask        (duration + easing)
     .spr     — opacity/translate written by the JS spring solver
     Delays and stagger are written inline by the script from CONFIG.
     ========================================================================== */
  .lt {
    display: inline-block; transform: translateY(100%); opacity: 0;
    transition: transform var(--gl-duration-slow) var(--gl-ease),
                opacity   var(--gl-duration-slow) var(--gl-ease);
  }
  .-in .lt { transform: none; opacity: 1; }

  .lnmask { display: block; overflow: hidden; }
  .lnmask > span {
    display: block; transform: translateY(110%); opacity: 0;
    transition: transform 760ms var(--gl-ease), opacity 760ms var(--gl-ease);
  }
  .-in .lnmask > span { transform: none; opacity: 1; }

  .spr { opacity: 0; }

  /* replay only — mute transitions for one frame so the reset doesn't animate */
  body.-nomotion .lt, body.-nomotion .lnmask > span { transition: none !important; }

  /* ==========================================================================
     REPLAY — demo affordance only. Delete with the #replay node to ship.
     ========================================================================== */
  #replay {
    position: fixed; z-index: 200; top: 12px; right: 12px;
    padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid var(--gl-line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gl-bg) 80%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    color: var(--gl-ink-muted); font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--gl-font-body);
    letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .5s ease;
  }
  #replay.-on { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
  #replay:hover { color: var(--gl-ink); border-color: var(--gl-accent); }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .lt, .lnmask > span { transition: none !important; transform: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; }
    #loader { transition: none !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============================ THE PAGE (gated) ============================ -->
<main id="page">
  <section class="hero" id="top">
    <div class="hero__top">
      <h2 class="hero__roles disp" id="roles">
        <span class="lnmask"><span>Founder</span></span>
        <span class="lnmask"><span>Investor</span></span>
        <span class="lnmask"><span>Operator</span></span>
        <span class="lnmask"><span>Contrarian</span></span>
      </h2>
      <p class="hero__intro spr" id="intro">
        I start companies that shouldn't be possible — then make them inevitable.
        Four exits, one playbook: conviction before consensus.
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- stand-in for the template's cutout portrait (see header comment) -->
    <div class="hero__figure" aria-hidden="true"><span>figure · stand-in</span></div>
    <div class="hero__scrim" aria-hidden="true"></div>

    <h1 class="hero__mark disp" id="mark">
      <span class="ln" data-letters>Marcus</span>
      <span class="ln" data-letters>Vane</span>
    </h1>

    <p class="hero__cue spr" id="cue"><b aria-hidden="true"></b>Scroll to enter</p>
  </section>

  <section class="after">
    <p>Everything below the fold is ordinary. The gate is only closed for the length of the
    count — once the curtain settles, scroll is handed back and the page behaves like any
    other page.</p>
  </section>
</main>

<!-- ============================== THE LOADER =============================== -->
<div id="loader">
  <p class="ld-name disp">Marcus Vane</p>
  <p class="ld-count disp"><span id="ld-num">0</span><i>%</i></p>
</div>

<button id="replay" type="button">Replay</button>

<script>
/* ============================================================================
   CONFIG — THE ASSET. Lifted verbatim from the template. Do not "tidy" these.
   ========================================================================== */
const CONFIG = {
  /* --- loader ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  COUNT_MS:       2000,   // 0→100, LINEAR (react-spring `config:{duration}` eases linearly)
  LABEL_FADE_MS:  300,    // labels blink out the moment the count rests (CSS, linear)
  WIPE_DELAY_MS:  200,    // hold on the full plate before it moves
  WIPE_SPRING:    { tension: 90, friction: 20, mass: 1 },  // lifts the plate a full 100%
  /* Scroll unlocks on the WIPE SPRING'S REST — not on a timer, not at 100%. */

  /* --- content, on its own absolute clock from mount --------------------- */
  REVEAL_DELAY:   2500,   // the crossing point: content starts BEFORE the curtain clears
  MARK_LINE_STEP:  240,   // +ms per wordmark line
  MARK_LETTER_STAGGER: 52,
  MARK_LETTER_MS:  900,   // easeOutExpo
  ROLE_OFFSET:     200,   // REVEAL_DELAY + 200 + i*80
  ROLE_STEP:        80,
  ROLE_MS:         760,   // easeOutExpo
  INTRO_OFFSET:    400,   // REVEAL_DELAY + 400
  INTRO_SPRING:   { tension: 180, friction: 26, mass: 1 },
  INTRO_FROM:     { opacity: 0, y: 16 },
  INTRO_TO:       { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
  CUE_OFFSET:      900,   // REVEAL_DELAY + 900
  CUE_SPRING:     { tension: 170, friction: 26, mass: 1 },  // react-spring default
};

/* ============================================================================
   SPRING SOLVER — react-spring's own integrator: fixed 1ms step,
   tension scaled by 1e-6 and friction by 1e-3 so the constants read in ms.
   Same numbers in, same curve out.
   ========================================================================== */
function spring({ from = 0, to = 1, config = {}, onChange, onRest }) {
  const tension  = config.tension  ?? 170;
  const friction = config.friction ?? 26;
  const mass     = config.mass     ?? 1;
  const precision = config.precision ??
    (from === to ? 0.005 : Math.min(1, Math.abs(to - from) * 0.001));

  let position = from, velocity = 0, last = null, raf = 0, cancelled = false;

  function tick(now) {
    if (cancelled) return;
    if (last === null) last = now;
    let elapsed = Math.min(64, now - last);   // clamp after a tab-switch
    last = now;

    for (let i = 0; i < elapsed; i++) {       // 1ms fixed steps
      const springForce  = -tension  * 0.000001 * (position - to);
      const dampingForce = -friction * 0.001    * velocity;
      velocity += ((springForce + dampingForce) / mass) * 1;
      position += velocity * 1;
    }

    const atRest = Math.abs(velocity) < precision && Math.abs(to - position) <= precision;
    if (atRest) position = to;
    onChange && onChange(position);
    if (atRest) { onRest && onRest(); return; }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  return () => { cancelled = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
}

const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;

/* ============================================================================
   THE GATE — the store flag + the DOM lock, latched together.
   In the template this is a zustand store read by the Lenis controller:
   the preloader calls stop() on mount and start() on the wipe spring's rest.
   ========================================================================== */
const gate = {
  stop() { document.documentElement.classList.add('-gated'); window.scrollTo(0, 0); },
  start() { document.documentElement.classList.remove('-gated'); },
};

/* ============================================================================
   SPLIT — one inline-block per letter, inside a per-line mask. Words are kept
   whole (nowrap) so a line break can never split a word mid-reveal.
   ========================================================================== */
function splitLetters(line) {
  const text = line.textContent;
  line.textContent = '';
  for (const token of text.split(/(\s+)/)) {
    if (!token) continue;
    if (/^\s+$/.test(token)) { line.appendChild(document.createTextNode(token)); continue; }
    const w = document.createElement('span');
    w.style.display = 'inline-block';
    w.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';
    for (const ch of token) {
      const s = document.createElement('span');
      s.className = 'lt';
      s.textContent = ch;
      w.appendChild(s);
    }
    line.appendChild(w);
  }
}

/* ============================================================================
   RUN
   ========================================================================== */
const loader  = document.getElementById('loader');
const num     = document.getElementById('ld-num');
const mark    = document.getElementById('mark');
const roles   = document.getElementById('roles');
const intro   = document.getElementById('intro');
const cue     = document.getElementById('cue');
const replay  = document.getElementById('replay');

let timers = [], stops = [];
const after = (ms, fn) => timers.push(setTimeout(fn, ms));

function reset() {
  timers.forEach(clearTimeout); timers = [];
  stops.forEach(fn => fn());    stops = [];

  loader.classList.remove('-done');
  loader.style.transform = 'translateY(0%)';
  loader.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  num.textContent = '0';

  // snap the reveals back with transitions muted, so a replay starts clean
  document.body.classList.add('-nomotion');
  mark.classList.remove('-in');
  roles.classList.remove('-in');
  void document.body.offsetHeight;                 // flush
  document.body.classList.remove('-nomotion');

  intro.style.opacity = 0; intro.style.transform = 'translateY(16px)';
  cue.style.opacity = 0;
  replay.classList.remove('-on');
}

function run() {
  reset();
  gate.stop();

  /* --- the counter: LINEAR, 2000ms, 0→100 ------------------------------- */
  const t0 = performance.now();
  (function count(now) {
    const p = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / CONFIG.COUNT_MS);
    num.textContent = Math.round(p * 100);
    if (p < 1) { requestAnimationFrame(count); return; }

    /* --- rest: labels blink out, then the plate holds, then it lifts ----- */
    loader.classList.add('-done');                        // 300ms opacity, linear
    after(CONFIG.WIPE_DELAY_MS, () => {                   // 200ms hold
      stops.push(spring({
        from: 0, to: 1, config: CONFIG.WIPE_SPRING,
        onChange: p => { loader.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (p * -100) + '%)'; },
        onRest: () => {                                   // ← THE UNLOCK
          gate.start();
          loader.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
          replay.classList.add('-on');
        },
      }));
    });
  })(t0);

  /* --- the content clock, running in parallel from mount ---------------- */

  // wordmark — per line, per letter. Line i starts at REVEAL_DELAY + i*240.
  mark.querySelectorAll('[data-letters]').forEach((line, i) => {
    splitLetters(line);
    const base = i * CONFIG.MARK_LINE_STEP;                 // relative to REVEAL_DELAY
    line.querySelectorAll('.lt').forEach((s, n) => {
      const d = base + n * CONFIG.MARK_LETTER_STAGGER;
      s.style.transitionDelay = d + 'ms, ' + d + 'ms';
    });
  });
  after(CONFIG.REVEAL_DELAY, () => mark.classList.add('-in'));

  // role words — line masks, REVEAL_DELAY + 200 + i*80
  roles.querySelectorAll('.lnmask > span').forEach((s, i) => {
    const d = CONFIG.ROLE_OFFSET + i * CONFIG.ROLE_STEP;
    s.style.transitionDelay = d + 'ms, ' + d + 'ms';
  });
  after(CONFIG.REVEAL_DELAY, () => roles.classList.add('-in'));

  // intro — spring 180/26, opacity 0→1 and y 16→0, at REVEAL_DELAY + 400
  after(CONFIG.REVEAL_DELAY + CONFIG.INTRO_OFFSET, () => {
    stops.push(spring({
      from: 0, to: 1, config: CONFIG.INTRO_SPRING,
      onChange: p => {
        intro.style.opacity = lerp(CONFIG.INTRO_FROM.opacity, CONFIG.INTRO_TO.opacity, p);
        intro.style.transform =
          'translateY(' + lerp(CONFIG.INTRO_FROM.y, CONFIG.INTRO_TO.y, p) + 'px)';
      },
    }));
  });

  // scroll cue — default spring, opacity only, at REVEAL_DELAY + 900
  after(CONFIG.REVEAL_DELAY + CONFIG.CUE_OFFSET, () => {
    stops.push(spring({
      from: 0, to: 1, config: CONFIG.CUE_SPRING,
      onChange: p => { cue.style.opacity = p; },
    }));
  });
}

replay.addEventListener('click', run);
run();
</script>
</body>
</html>

overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; }\n\n  /* scroll cue */\n  .hero__cue {\n    position: absolute; bottom: 2rem; left: var(--gutter); z-index: 30;\n    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; margin: 0;\n    font-size: clamp(11px, .7vw, 13px); letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase;\n    color: var(--gl-ink-muted);\n  }\n  .hero__cue b { display: inline-block; width: 2.5rem; height: 1px; background: var(--gl-accent); }\n\n  /* a second block, so there is somewhere to scroll once the gate opens */\n  .after {\n    border-top: 1px solid var(--gl-line);\n    padding: 9rem var(--gutter);\n    font-size: clamp(14px, .95vw, 18px); line-height: 1.6; color: var(--gl-ink-muted);\n  }\n  .after p { max-width: 46ch; margin: 0; }\n\n  /* ==========================================================================\n     REVEAL PRIMITIVES\n     .ln>.lt  — per-letter rise out of a line mask   (duration + easing)\n     .lnmask  — whole-line rise out of a mask        (duration + easing)\n     .spr     — opacity/translate written by the JS spring solver\n     Delays and stagger are written inline by the script from CONFIG.\n     ========================================================================== */\n  .lt {\n    display: inline-block; transform: translateY(100%); opacity: 0;\n    transition: transform var(--gl-duration-slow) var(--gl-ease),\n                opacity   var(--gl-duration-slow) var(--gl-ease);\n  }\n  .-in .lt { transform: none; opacity: 1; }\n\n  .lnmask { display: block; overflow: hidden; }\n  .lnmask > span {\n    display: block; transform: translateY(110%); opacity: 0;\n    transition: transform 760ms var(--gl-ease), opacity 760ms var(--gl-ease);\n  }\n  .-in .lnmask > span { transform: none; opacity: 1; }\n\n  .spr { opacity: 0; }\n\n  /* replay only — mute transitions for one frame so the reset doesn't animate */\n  body.-nomotion .lt, body.-nomotion .lnmask > span { transition: none !important; }\n\n  /* ==========================================================================\n     REPLAY — demo affordance only. Delete with the #replay node to ship.\n     ========================================================================== */\n  #replay {\n    position: fixed; z-index: 200; top: 12px; right: 12px;\n    padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 999px;\n    border: 1px solid var(--gl-line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gl-bg) 80%, transparent);\n    backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);\n    color: var(--gl-ink-muted); font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--gl-font-body);\n    letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer;\n    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .5s ease;\n  }\n  #replay.-on { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }\n  #replay:hover { color: var(--gl-ink); border-color: var(--gl-accent); }\n\n  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n    .lt, .lnmask > span { transition: none !important; transform: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; }\n    #loader { transition: none !important; }\n  }\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<!-- ============================ THE PAGE (gated) ============================ -->\n<main id=\"page\">\n  <section class=\"hero\" id=\"top\">\n    <div class=\"hero__top\">\n      <h2 class=\"hero__roles disp\" id=\"roles\">\n        <span class=\"lnmask\"><span>Founder</span></span>\n        <span class=\"lnmask\"><span>Investor</span></span>\n        <span class=\"lnmask\"><span>Operator</span></span>\n        <span class=\"lnmask\"><span>Contrarian</span></span>\n      </h2>\n      <p class=\"hero__intro spr\" id=\"intro\">\n        I start companies that shouldn't be possible — then make them inevitable.\n        Four exits, one playbook: conviction before consensus.\n      </p>\n    </div>\n\n    <!-- stand-in for the template's cutout portrait (see header comment) -->\n    <div class=\"hero__figure\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span>figure · stand-in</span></div>\n    <div class=\"hero__scrim\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>\n\n    <h1 class=\"hero__mark disp\" id=\"mark\">\n      <span class=\"ln\" data-letters>Marcus</span>\n      <span class=\"ln\" data-letters>Vane</span>\n    </h1>\n\n    <p class=\"hero__cue spr\" id=\"cue\"><b aria-hidden=\"true\"></b>Scroll to enter</p>\n  </section>\n\n  <section class=\"after\">\n    <p>Everything below the fold is ordinary. The gate is only closed for the length of the\n    count — once the curtain settles, scroll is handed back and the page behaves like any\n    other page.</p>\n  </section>\n</main>\n\n<!-- ============================== THE LOADER =============================== -->\n<div id=\"loader\">\n  <p class=\"ld-name disp\">Marcus Vane</p>\n  <p class=\"ld-count disp\"><span id=\"ld-num\">0</span><i>%</i></p>\n</div>\n\n<button id=\"replay\" type=\"button\">Replay</button>\n\n<script>\n/* ============================================================================\n   CONFIG — THE ASSET. Lifted verbatim from the template. Do not \"tidy\" these.\n   ========================================================================== */\nconst CONFIG = {\n  /* --- loader ------------------------------------------------------------ */\n  COUNT_MS:       2000,   // 0→100, LINEAR (react-spring `config:{duration}` eases linearly)\n  LABEL_FADE_MS:  300,    // labels blink out the moment the count rests (CSS, linear)\n  WIPE_DELAY_MS:  200,    // hold on the full plate before it moves\n  WIPE_SPRING:    { tension: 90, friction: 20, mass: 1 },  // lifts the plate a full 100%\n  /* Scroll unlocks on the WIPE SPRING'S REST — not on a timer, not at 100%. */\n\n  /* --- content, on its own absolute clock from mount --------------------- */\n  REVEAL_DELAY:   2500,   // the crossing point: content starts BEFORE the curtain clears\n  MARK_LINE_STEP:  240,   // +ms per wordmark line\n  MARK_LETTER_STAGGER: 52,\n  MARK_LETTER_MS:  900,   // easeOutExpo\n  ROLE_OFFSET:     200,   // REVEAL_DELAY + 200 + i*80\n  ROLE_STEP:        80,\n  ROLE_MS:         760,   // easeOutExpo\n  INTRO_OFFSET:    400,   // REVEAL_DELAY + 400\n  INTRO_SPRING:   { tension: 180, friction: 26, mass: 1 },\n  INTRO_FROM:     { opacity: 0, y: 16 },\n  INTRO_TO:       { opacity: 1, y: 0 },\n  CUE_OFFSET:      900,   // REVEAL_DELAY + 900\n  CUE_SPRING:     { tension: 170, friction: 26, mass: 1 },  // react-spring default\n};\n\n/* ============================================================================\n   SPRING SOLVER — react-spring's own integrator: fixed 1ms step,\n   tension scaled by 1e-6 and friction by 1e-3 so the constants read in ms.\n   Same numbers in, same curve out.\n   ========================================================================== */\nfunction spring({ from = 0, to = 1, config = {}, onChange, onRest }) {\n  const tension  = config.tension  ?? 170;\n  const friction = config.friction ?? 26;\n  const mass     = config.mass     ?? 1;\n  const precision = config.precision ??\n    (from === to ? 0.005 : Math.min(1, Math.abs(to - from) * 0.001));\n\n  let position = from, velocity = 0, last = null, raf = 0, cancelled = false;\n\n  function tick(now) {\n    if (cancelled) return;\n    if (last === null) last = now;\n    let elapsed = Math.min(64, now - last);   // clamp after a tab-switch\n    last = now;\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < elapsed; i++) {       // 1ms fixed steps\n      const springForce  = -tension  * 0.000001 * (position - to);\n      const dampingForce = -friction * 0.001    * velocity;\n      velocity += ((springForce + dampingForce) / mass) * 1;\n      position += velocity * 1;\n    }\n\n    const atRest = Math.abs(velocity) < precision && Math.abs(to - position) <= precision;\n    if (atRest) position = to;\n    onChange && onChange(position);\n    if (atRest) { onRest && onRest(); return; }\n    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);\n  }\n  raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);\n  return () => { cancelled = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };\n}\n\nconst lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;\n\n/* ============================================================================\n   THE GATE — the store flag + the DOM lock, latched together.\n   In the template this is a zustand store read by the Lenis controller:\n   the preloader calls stop() on mount and start() on the wipe spring's rest.\n   ========================================================================== */\nconst gate = {\n  stop() { document.documentElement.classList.add('-gated'); window.scrollTo(0, 0); },\n  start() { document.documentElement.classList.remove('-gated'); },\n};\n\n/* ============================================================================\n   SPLIT — one inline-block per letter, inside a per-line mask. Words are kept\n   whole (nowrap) so a line break can never split a word mid-reveal.\n   ========================================================================== */\nfunction splitLetters(line) {\n  const text = line.textContent;\n  line.textContent = '';\n  for (const token of text.split(/(\\s+)/)) {\n    if (!token) continue;\n    if (/^\\s+$/.test(token)) { line.appendChild(document.createTextNode(token)); continue; }\n    const w = document.createElement('span');\n    w.style.display = 'inline-block';\n    w.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';\n    for (const ch of token) {\n      const s = document.createElement('span');\n      s.className = 'lt';\n      s.textContent = ch;\n      w.appendChild(s);\n    }\n    line.appendChild(w);\n  }\n}\n\n/* ============================================================================\n   RUN\n   ========================================================================== */\nconst loader  = document.getElementById('loader');\nconst num     = document.getElementById('ld-num');\nconst mark    = document.getElementById('mark');\nconst roles   = document.getElementById('roles');\nconst intro   = document.getElementById('intro');\nconst cue     = document.getElementById('cue');\nconst replay  = document.getElementById('replay');\n\nlet timers = [], stops = [];\nconst after = (ms, fn) => timers.push(setTimeout(fn, ms));\n\nfunction reset() {\n  timers.forEach(clearTimeout); timers = [];\n  stops.forEach(fn => fn());    stops = [];\n\n  loader.classList.remove('-done');\n  loader.style.transform = 'translateY(0%)';\n  loader.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';\n  num.textContent = '0';\n\n  // snap the reveals back with transitions muted, so a replay starts clean\n  document.body.classList.add('-nomotion');\n  mark.classList.remove('-in');\n  roles.classList.remove('-in');\n  void document.body.offsetHeight;                 // flush\n  document.body.classList.remove('-nomotion');\n\n  intro.style.opacity = 0; intro.style.transform = 'translateY(16px)';\n  cue.style.opacity = 0;\n  replay.classList.remove('-on');\n}\n\nfunction run() {\n  reset();\n  gate.stop();\n\n  /* --- the counter: LINEAR, 2000ms, 0→100 ------------------------------- */\n  const t0 = performance.now();\n  (function count(now) {\n    const p = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / CONFIG.COUNT_MS);\n    num.textContent = Math.round(p * 100);\n    if (p < 1) { requestAnimationFrame(count); return; }\n\n    /* --- rest: labels blink out, then the plate holds, then it lifts ----- */\n    loader.classList.add('-done');                        // 300ms opacity, linear\n    after(CONFIG.WIPE_DELAY_MS, () => {                   // 200ms hold\n      stops.push(spring({\n        from: 0, to: 1, config: CONFIG.WIPE_SPRING,\n        onChange: p => { loader.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (p * -100) + '%)'; },\n        onRest: () => {                                   // ← THE UNLOCK\n          gate.start();\n          loader.style.pointerEvents = 'none';\n          replay.classList.add('-on');\n        },\n      }));\n    });\n  })(t0);\n\n  /* --- the content clock, running in parallel from mount ---------------- */\n\n  // wordmark — per line, per letter.         "id": "aerra",
        "title": "Aerra",
        "description": "A six-section landing page for a single finished house standing alone on a mountain slope. It opens behind a white curtain whose percentage counter runs 0 → 100 along the bottom edge and then leaves through a rounded hole that grows out of the sheet until it clears the viewport; only then does the hero play, the brand name writing itself in letter by letter at 801px behind a cut-out dusk photograph, then the headline word by word, then the subtitle, the button and the caption. Scrolling splits the wordmark — alternating letters climb 14rem and 5rem against the scroll while a white-to-transparent gradient runs down each glyph — and every photograph on the page drifts against the scroll inside its own clip box. The about block pairs a quote card laid over the facade with a drag-to-rotate turntable: a video that is never played but seeked frame by frame, playing itself through once on arrival and draggable by the surface or by a pill scrubber, either of which cancels the playthrough rather than fighting it. Three statistics count up out of a blur that resolves off the same spring that drives the number. The location section is a night photograph of the ridge with a site plan painted into it by the cursor — a raw-WebGL pass keeping an 84 × 56 heat grid on the CPU and sampling it NEAREST, so the grid's own cells are the pixels of the reveal. The audience block is a 3 × 3 grid of frosted glass cards with the centre and both counter-diagonal cells left empty, and a matte-black three.js mark travelling the whole height of the section behind them, turning twice, clipped by the section's own edges so it rises from under one block and slides away under the next. It closes on a frosted contact panel with three underlined fields whose labels are their own placeholders.",
        "vibes": [
          "a house alone on a slope, sold slowly and with a straight face",
          "eight hundred pixels of a name standing behind a building",
          "a counter that walks along the bottom of the screen and then drops off it",
          "a window opening in a white sheet instead of the sheet fading",
          "letters that come apart as you scroll and never stop being a word",
          "turning a facade in your hand at the speed of your own drag",
          "painting a site plan into a photograph with the cursor",

A second line opens the model for good and the mesh's junctions TRAVEL across the stage — ranked by column and matched like to like — to assemble an authored 3D mark that reads \"AI\", whose star spins in place; chrome pours up through the letters from the bottom with a bright waterline, blooms, reflects a painted studio of bands and strips, and the word turns a full revolution while \"What lands in your Drive\" hangs four deliverables under a rule the scene draws beneath the word. Then seven photographs travel down the screen round a BOX seen edge-on, each card cut into eighteen bands so it folds over the crease rather than tipping, with the three process steps inking in across them in reading order; and the closing screen rides up on a 36-degree tilted blue plane that lands flat — \"Book a batch\" behind a cutout of the same bust, its foot already dissolved into the accent, the invitation and a magnetic e-mail pill leading and lagging against the panel. A floating pill of four section links opens out of a disc from the centre of the screen once the first screen is behind you and leaves before the plane climbs.
